technical-summary: Added fail-closed offline validation for SMI/device-state evidence: explicit unavailable reasons, identity/BDF validation, clock/thermal/power field completeness, zero-evidence rejection, drift status validation, and release-gate integration when device evidence is present. Runtime HIP telemetry collection is unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Added HI60 device-text evidence validation so missing or zero-valued clock, thermal, and power readings cannot silently count as hardware evidence.

technical-summary: Added strict offline loading of recognized compiler resource-report exclusions and catalog filtering for generated candidates. Blacklisted architectures are removed per candidate while unaffected architectures remain; native wrappers are unchanged. Added focused parser and catalog regressions.
user-summary-candidate: HI09b now consumes validated compiler resource reports to exclude unviable generated geometries with explicit reasons before manifest generation, without changing runtime launch or release/replay formats.
